facts.text: The deliverable adds an offline unified entry under skills/zcode-mmx-review that hands the same logical review packet to both the ZCode and MMX sides.
Both sides are adjudicated by the same validator, skills/zcode/scripts/review.js validateReview, on the evidence IDs derived from the packet facts.
The fixture backend only runs the fixed fake wrappers under tests/fixtures/backends and never contacts a network endpoint.
The real backend is a reserved value and exits with code 2 before reading any input or starting any process.

constraints: No real model calls, logins, credentials, or package installs during this stage.
Every run directory is created new with mode 0700 and its records are written with mode 0600.
assumptions: The repository layout keeps skills/zcode and skills/mmx next to skills/zcode-mmx-review.
uncovered: Behaviour of the real backend and of process-tree supervision on Windows.
